verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Go ye therefore and teach all nations
Go, Go, Go
Go ye therefore and teach all nations
Go, Go, Go
Baptizing them in the name of the
Father and Son and Holy Ghost
Go, Go, Go

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
If you love Me really love Me
Feed My sheep
If you love Me really love Me
Feed My sheep
Lo, I'll be with you forever and ever
until the end of the world
Go, Go, Go
